code.name: COMPLEX ACTION
code.desc: A COMPLEX action is achieved by sacrificing either a QUICK action or MOVE action to enhance your STANDARD action, turning it into a COMPLEX action.

code.name: MOVEMENT
code.desc: Move up to 5m in a round. You can also use a STANDARD action to move allowing for an additional movement action. If your previous action was a move you can instead RUN (see description). You can also change stance (prone, crouch) this counts as moving 1 meter.

code.name: RUN
code.desc: If your last action was a move action you can replace your MOVE with a RUN action. RUN double your movement speed. If you stop at any point, you must MOVE again before running again.

code.name: MOVEMENT (in combat)
code.desc: During a round where you have moved, you gain a SMALL BONUS to your defense VS any attacks performed against you. Because you moved you also have a SMALL penalty to all skill checks.

code.name: RUN (in combat)
code.desc: When running, increase the move DEFENSE bonus to LARGE and the move SKILL check penalty to LARGE.

code.name: QUICK ACTION
code.desc: Quick actions can be performed at any point during the round (including enemy turn). If you call a QUICK action during someone else's turn you must win initiative. (See INTERUPTS and REACTIONS)

code.name: QUICK ATTACK
code.desc: Any power, weapon or item that has the QUICK keyword can be used to perform a BASIC ATTACK as a QUICK ACTION.

code.name: STANDARD ATTACK
code.desc: Normal attack, can be modified by various talents and circumstances.

code.name: SHIFT
code.desc: You can use a QUICK action to move up to 1m, change your stance (crouch, stand, prone). A SHIFT does not cause opportunity attacks when used to move out of the reach of a target.

code.name: BASIC ATTACK
code.desc: A basic attack is an attack that cannot be modified with talents, modifiers or outside help. You perform a skill check and apply the unmodified results.

code.name: DIFFICULT TERRAIN
code.desc: Environment not suitable for proper movement cost double movement per square (1m) special movement like stealth, climbing, swimming, no gravity have the same effect. Special movement through difficult terrain cost triple movement.

code.name: FOCUS
code.desc: In a challenge round, you can use your QUICK action to FOCUS. While focussed you gain a SMALL bonus to your next action.

code.name: BURST FIRE
code.desc: Weapons with a B in the R.O.F category can perform a BURST FIRE action. This is a STANDARD attack but the roll and damage is now lucky at the cost of 3 ammo

code.name: FULL AUTO
code.desc: Weapons with a F in the R.O.F category can perform a FULL AUTO action. Full auto is always COMPLEX action. On a FULL AUTO action your EXPERTISE result counts as additional hits instead of additional damage. You can distribute the hits among any targets within X (EXPERTISE) meters of the initial target.

code.name: DUAL WEAPONS
code.desc: Need one handed weapons, when attacking you repeat your action with a secondary weapon and a SMALL penalty. Actions done through DW require the same target and actions. Reloading is per weapon still.

code.name: DEFEND
code.desc: If you win initiative, you can actively defend against an attack or event. The skill or method used to defend is up to the player as long as it is relevant(GM approval). On success you add the result of the skill to your DEFENSE roll. If you fail initiative, you were too slow.

code.name: FLANKED
code.desc: When you have two or more enemies at opposite sides of you are considered FLANKED. While FLANKED you are consided BREACHED.

code.name: PRECISION HIT
code.desc: You can take a SMALL penalty to a COMPLEX attack to target a specific location or object. (Can be used to hit armor weak spots, armor is treated as BREACHED for that hit but requires you to identify the armor type first via tactics)

code.name: CROUCHED
code.desc: Grants LIGHT COVER Vs ranged attacks. All movement is treated as being in difficult terrain. Your DEFENSE Vs MELEE has a SMALL penalty

code.name: PRONE
code.desc: Grants GOOD COVER vs ranged attacks. Your maximum movement is 2. Your DEFENSE Vs MELEE has a LARGE penalty.

code.name: COVER FIRE
code.desc: As a COMPLEX action you can perform a COVER FIRE action. Designate 3 (burst fire) or 9 (full auto) squares meters in weapon range as cover fire area (must be contiguous). Then roll your attack as normal; anyone you hit gains the SUPPRESSED AILMENT. If you perform any other actions others than cover fire of if the target leaves the area the SUPPRESSED ailment is removed.

code.name: SUPPRESSED
code.desc: While SUPPRESSED, any actions you perform first require a Willpower check (DC = shooters accuracy). On success you can act normally. On failure lose 1 morale and you are forced to use the next action to either move out of the cover fire area or move into better cover within the area. If either option is unavailable you must go PRONE on your location and cannot move.

code.name: LEADERSHIP
code.desc: Leadership can heal one point of morale. DC of the check is equal to the target's missing MORALE

code.name: TRAUMA
code.desc: Trauma is a keyword to indicate that the subject is suffering from an effect caused by high HEALTH or MORALE loss. LIGHT TRAUMA are GRAVE and SHAKEN. SEVERE TRAUMA is MORTAL and BROKEN

code.name: SLOW
code.desc: Maximum movement is 2, always lose initiative

code.name: DAZE
code.desc: Daze = can only perform one action this round and cannot use quick action

code.name: STUNNED
code.desc: While STUNNED you cannot act until you RECOVER from that ailment.

code.name: BREACHED
code.desc: When BREACHED your DEFENSE is reduced by a one category (No effect if [NONE]) until the next maintenance phase.

code.name: LOCKON
code.desc: While under the effect of lockon a target cannot stealth and will always grant line of sight (cover still applies).

code.name: FORCEFIELD / SHIELDS
code.desc: When damage exceeds the value of a shield or forcefield you ignore the rest of the hit no matter how much damage is left. (ie: shield gating).

code.name: CRITICAL DAMAGE
code.desc: Deal maximum damage (No dmg roll required), if the target suffers any damage from the attack that caused the hit they also gain a CRITICAL AILMENT. To score a critical hit a player must roll a natural 10 on their luck dice. To qualify as a critical hit the hit must have been a valid hit in the first place.

code.name: CRITICAL SUCCESS
code.desc: Grants the maximum number of success possible (replace the result of your skill roll). To achieve a critical success roll a player must roll a natural/modified 10 on their luck dice.

code.name: CRITICAL AILMENTS
code.desc: When a target loses HEALTH or MORALE from an attack that was either a CRITICAL HIT or has caused a TRAUMA, the target also suffers from a CRITICAL AILMENT. Effect is the critical ailment depends on the damage type that caused it (see critical ailment table below)

code.name: WOUND TRESHOLD
code.desc: When you suffer health damage in excess of your  endurance, you gain the grave wound status ailment; if you were already suffering from a grave wound you replace it to a mortal wound status. If you were already suffering from a mortal wound you go strait to the DYING status.

code.name: SANITY TRESHOLD
code.desc: When you suffer morale damage from an attack that exceeds your willpower modifier, you gain the shaken status ailment or broken status if you were already shaken.

code.name: GRAVE WOUND
code.desc: Grave wounds cause a SMALL penalty to the following attributes: PHYSICAL, ENDURANCE, ACUITY and SPEED.

code.name: MORTAL WOUND
code.desc: Mortal wounds cause a LARGE penalty to the following attributes: PHYSICAL, ENDURANCE, ACUITY and SPEED.

code.name: SHAKEN
code.desc: Shaken cause a SMALL penalty to the following attributes: MENTAL, WITS, SOCIAL and WILLPOWER.

code.name: BROKEN
code.desc: Broken cause a LARGE penalty to the following attributes: MENTAL, WITS, SOCIAL and WILLPOWER

code.name: DYING
code.desc: If you lose all your health, morale or suffer too many traumas you gain the DYING status. Dying characters lose consciousness and will die in 3 rounds unless someone stabilizes you  (Medicine DC 5 or Leadership DC5).

code.name: STUN DAMAGE
code.desc: Stun damage is temporary unless you take more stun damage than you have DEADLY left, when that happens overwrite the existing stun damage into normal damage. Stun damage is healed at the end of a scene.

code.name: RESISTANT
code.desc: Reduce damage by X of the type specified.

code.name: VULNERABLE
code.desc: Increase any damage taken (including ongoing damage) damage by the value of the vulnerability.

code.name: TOOLS
code.desc: Tools and options which help can provide a small or large bonus, some actions might require tools and instead of granting a bonus, tools will negate a penalty. GM's discretion.

code.name: MAX WEIGHT
code.desc: Players can carry a limited number of objects but they are also limited by WEIGHT. MAX WEIGHT is = 50 KG Modified by Physique times 5KG |  Lift = 5 time your total carry | Push or drag =  10 times your carry

code.name: BLEEDING
code.desc: Bleeding causes a character to lose 1 HEALTH every maintenance phase. (Recover or Medicine DC 1 to recover)

code.name: RECOVER
code.desc: During maintenance you can roll 1D for every ailment you are suffering from. On a 6+ you recover, on a failure the ailment continues.

code.name: BLIND
code.desc: When you try to perform a ranged action while suffering from BLIND you incur a LARGE penality. Touch and Melee actions have a SMALL penality.

code.name: COVER
code.desc: When next to object and structures, targets are considered to be using them as cover (unless stated otherwise). Attackers get the option to try to avoid hitting the cover, giving the attacker a skill check penalty or try to go through the cover which gives the defender bonus defense.

code.name: BAD COVER
code.desc: SMALL PENALTY or LOW to MEDIUM DEFENSE | Small appliances, a trashcan, small trees, lamppost, a car door, coffee table, plaster walls etc.

code.name: GOOD COVER
code.desc: LARGE PENALTY or HIGH to EXTREME DEFENSE | Reinforced items, metal plates, heavy concrete, large stone items, Large appliances, solid furniture, a car, brick or concrete walls, large trees etc.

code.name: TOTAL COVER
code.desc: Total cover means that the target is fully hidden from view. You cannot try to shoot around total cover but you can still shoot through; see BAD or GOOD cover for effects.

code.name: SLEEP
code.desc: Not sleeping will cause the SICK ailment if you go over 30 hours without rest. A 10 hour REST or a sleep replicator (COST 1 morale) will cure this ailment.

code.name: REST
code.desc: Resting for a period of 10 hours in a non threatening safe area will recover your ENDURANCE in HEALTH and WILLPOWER in MORALE.

code.name: SICK
code.desc: The sick ailment causes anyone to have a SMALL penalty to all ATTRIBUTES and DEFENSES. SICK cannot be removed through RECOVER, see the condition that applied SICK to find out how to remove it.

code.name: CLONE SICKNESS
code.desc: Anyone that has been cloned will suffer from the SICK ailment. This ailment cannot be removed by a RECOVER, instead it lasts until you gain 25 exp (or 2 weeks for anyone that cannot gain XP).

code.name: SKILL CHECK
code.desc: Roll a number of D10 equal to your skill rank, then add any bonus or penalty to the result. Compare result to the DC of the skill check

code.name: ATTRIBUTE BONUS
code.desc: When rolling a skill with an associated positive attribute you can reroll a number of failures equal to that attribute. In the case of a negative attribute you must reroll a number of successes.

code.name: SMALL BONUS
code.desc: Increase total successes of a roll by 1

code.name: LARGE BONUS
code.desc: Increase total successes of a roll by 3

code.name: SMALL PENALTY
code.desc: Decrease total successes of a roll by 1 (min 0)

code.name: DEFLECT
code.desc: Deflect gets added to your DEFENSE (along cover and other modifiers) to counter POWER and determine how much damage penetrates or is negated by the armor. A higher value will reduce damage while a lower value will hinder your ability to SOAK damage properly.

code.name: REGEN
code.desc: When SOAK run out a forcefield is rendered innactive. To recharge a forcefield, you must spend the time under "Regen" not being shot at. When that condition is true your forcefield returns during the next maintenance phase.

code.name: SOAK
code.desc: SOAK is the ability of a forcefield or Armor to reduce the damage of an attack. If the damage is reduced to 0 the attack is considered fully absorbed and no other effects are checked.

code.name: DAMAGE
code.desc: Damage determines the amount of damage a weapon does once a hit has passed defenses.

code.name: POWER
code.desc: Power determines the relative strength of the weapon and is a direct counter to DEFENSE. Every point of power above DEFENSE will deny SOAK and under will reduce damage by the same amount.

code.name: LIGHT ARMOR
code.desc: Provide basic protection and counts as a SMALL item for encumbrance. Requires 1 rounds to put on or remove.

code.name: MEDIUM ARMOR
code.desc: Provide good protection and counts as a MEDIUM item for encumbrance. Requires 2 rounds to put on or remove.

code.name: HEAVY ARMOR
code.desc: Provide excellent protection and counts as a LARGE item for encumbrance. Requires 3 rounds to put on or remove.

code.name: POWERED ARMOR
code.desc: Modifies a suit of ARMOR so that it's encumbrance no longer applies. However, powered armors give a SMALL penalty to all ACUITY and PHYSICAL checks.

code.name: SPECIAL
code.desc: Special is a section that lists any special property the armor, weapon, forcefield or device might have.

code.name: LARGE PENALTY
code.desc: Decrease total successes of a roll by 3 (min 0)

code.name: AMMO
code.desc: The quantity and type of ammo the weapon has in its magazine. Energy weapons tend to have a power cell giving X shots before it is depleted and automatically begins recharging (cooldown period). Ammunition is universal and comes in 3 sizes small S, medium M and large L.

code.name: INSTANT DETONATION
code.desc: You can take a SMALL penality to your DEXTERITY roll to prevents targets from performing any actions before detonation.

code.name: EXPERTISE
code.desc: Expertise represents the ease of use of an item. Expertise only applies when making COMPLEX actions unless the value is negative, then it applies on all actions. EXPERTISE adds 1 DAMAGE per extra success over your DIFFICULTY to hit up to the maximum EXPERTISE rating of the weapon. Negative expertise increases the DC of all skill rolls by X.

code.name: LEGALITY
code.desc: Legality class determines whether it is legal or not to carry such an item under the alliance law. Outside of the alliance, laws are usually localized.

code.name: OPERATION
code.desc: Modifies existing function of an item.

code.name: DC
code.desc: Difficulty is the target number of successes required to succeed at a task.

code.name: AVAILABILITY
code.desc: Availability governs the rarity of certain items. Players can search for vendors, ask contacts or just ask around to see if they can find the required item.

code.name: DOMAIN
code.desc: Magic is divised in DOMAINS, each of them regroups SPIRITS, SPELLS, BARRIERS and is associated with it's appropriate SKILL.

code.name: SIZE
code.desc: Indicate how big and bulky an item is

code.name: MEMORY
code.desc: Total data capacity your device can hold. Your ROUTINES, PROGRAMS and TOOLS reduce this capacity.

code.name: CPU
code.desc: How many ROUTINES, PROGRAMS, GADGETS or ACTIONS can this device handle every round. ROUTINES only consume CPU when active.

code.name: SYSTEM
code.desc: How many HACKS it takes to render this device innactive. Any devices with no SYSTEM stat goes down in 1 HACK. Devices with 0 SYSTEM can be repaired (takes 1 scene)

code.name: WALL
code.desc: How much defense against MORALE attacks your device grants.

code.name: INTEGRITY
code.desc: How much MORALE damage you can SOAK. Stacks with user's WILLPOWER defensive attribute

code.name: NANITES
code.desc: NANITES are a special ressources that powers nanomachines and enable and enables your DATACOM to form or interact with physical objects in the real world. NANITES recharge after a SCENE.

code.name: RANGE
code.desc: Datacoms have a default range of melee, 100m, 1000m (Skill penalties are  0/1/3). In Melee range you are considered connected directly.

code.name: DEVICE
code.desc: A device is a single function tool that can connect to a node (Forcefield,  most drones, guns, etc.). Unless specified devices have an INTEGRITY of 1. You do not hack devices directly, you hack their NODE

code.name: NODE
code.desc: A node is a intelligentdevice that exists within a network or by itself and that has a FIREWALL and can run ROUTINES or have devices connect to it. (Datacom, intelligent devices, advanced drones, etc.)

code.name: ROUTINE
code.desc: A set of instructions that can run on a datacom. ROUTINES consume CPU to stay active and provides passive benefits to anyone connected to the network.

code.name: PROGRAM
code.desc: A program is something you can use as a standard action to replace basic hacking action. Programs only cost MEMORY.

code.name: GADGET
code.desc: A set of instructions for your DATACOM to build temporary constructs that have various effects. Unless specified using a GADGET is a standard action and last a SCENE unless specified.

code.name: NETWORK
code.desc: Allows private sharing of anything in memory to any connected NODES within range. Any REMOTE NODE attacks against a NETWORK is done against the NETWORK CONTROLLER.

code.name: BASIC DATACOMS
code.desc: Your basic multi use communication device. Basic datacoms can be part of a network but cannot create one.

code.name: FULL DATACOMS
code.desc: An advanced datacom that functions like a basic datacom but more powerful and can act as a HOST NODE to form a NETWORK

code.name: LOCAL NODE
code.desc: A datacom, server or device which you are directly using by being physically connected to. Being physically connected automatically bypass the NETWORK and you instead deals with the local device defenses.

code.name: REMOTE NODE
code.desc: A datacom, server or network in range of your datacom which you have no physical connection to. Defense is always set by network and HACKING actions when on a remote NODE can suffer a penalty based on the range.

code.name: DURABILITY
code.desc: Replaces HEALTH for nonliving things like vehicles, ships, drones, buildings, etc

code.name: STRUCTURE
code.desc: STRUCTURE is the damage threshold for DURABILITY TRAUMA.

code.name: CRIPPLED
code.desc: CRIPPLED is a SEVERE TRAUMA for objects and machines. An ITEM that is CRIPPLED loses access to EXTERNAL and INTERNAL components.

code.name: SCRAPPED
code.desc: Scrapped indicates that an object or item stops functioning completely. Nothing works anymore, item will have to be repaired before it can be used again.

code.name: DESTROYED
code.desc: Destroyed happens when you lose more than 2x your HEALTH, HULL, MORALE or SYSTEM. Anything suffering a destroyed result is obliterated beyond any recovery.

code.name: COMPROMISED
code.desc: COMPROMISED is a LIGHT TRAUMA for objects and machines. An ITEM that is COMPROMISED loses access to EXTERNAL components

code.name: SHIP CLASS
code.desc: The class of a ship determines which category it belongs to: Ship classes from smallest to largest are Drones, Fighters, Corvettes, Frigates, Cruisers, Battlecruisers, Carriers and Nova Cruisers.

code.name: SHIP TYPE
code.desc: The type of a ship determines which subclass the ship belongs to and will determine it's internal configurations, role and components.

code.name: SHIP MINIMUM CREW
code.desc: The minimum amount of personnel required on a ship to operate it. Anyone operating on a ship under minimum crew has a LARGE penalty to all their skill checks.

code.name: SHIP MAXIMUM CREW
code.desc: The maximum crew is the amount of personal required to fully staff a ship. Anyone operating on a ship under maximum crew has a SMALL penalty to all their skill checks.

code.name: SHIP ATMOSPHERIC CAPABILITY
code.desc: Very few ships can handle going into an atmosphere; when they do this is marked as FULL or HALF. HALF only allows takeoff and landing while FULL allows full capabilities within atmosphere.

code.name: SHIP SPEED
code.desc: The speed of ships is normalized to 3 distinct values: LOW, MEDIUM and HIGH. (you can always lower your speed). Ship speed has no effect on jump range. See SHIP speed section of SPACE rules for more details.

code.name: SHIP MAX PASSENGERS
code.desc: Indicates how many passengers this ship can carry. Crew and passengers count separately on a ship and will more than likely have different accommodations. Life support will also match the maximum passenger count.

code.name: SHIP LIFE SUPPORT
code.desc: This value lets you know how long your life support can handle a full load of passengers on board in optimal conditions. Having more people than life support will lead to death.

code.name: SHIP AVAILABLE POWER
code.desc: Spaceships need power for their various components, if there's a surplus it will be listed as available power. This can be used for various things like weapons, shields or various systems.

code.name: SHIP SHIELD
code.desc: Shields on spaceships function as damage buffer. Any damage done will impact shields first. If no shields are available then the damage goes directly into HULL or SYSTEM.

code.name: SHIP SHIELD RECHARGE
code.desc: Shield recharge on a spaceship indicates how many units of power you can send to the shield to recharge an equal amount.

code.name: SHIP STRUCTURE
code.desc: Structure is the damage threshold that your HULL can take before you are COMPROMISED or CRIPPLED. Any hull damage exceeding this value in a single hit will cause one of those TRAUMA.

code.name: SHIP HULL
code.desc: Hull is your ship's durability. Taking damage will lower this value. It can be repaired using resources but does not recover naturally. If your HULL reaches 0 your ship is SCRAPPED.

code.name: SHIP ECM
code.desc: ECM stands for electronic counter measures and the value indicates your ship's SYSTEM damage threshold. Any system damage exceeding this value in a single hit will cause a TRAUMA.

code.name: SHIP SYSTEM
code.desc: System is your ship's electronics' durability, taking system damage will lower this value. It can be repaired using resources but does not recover naturally. If your SYSTEM reaches 0 your ship is SCRAPPED.

code.name: SHIP CARGO
code.desc: The value on your ship's cargo indicates how many units of cargo you can fit in that area. One unit of ship cargo is equal to one HUGE item.

code.name: SHIP COMBAT RANGE
code.desc: The combat range is your ship's weapon range, weapons that exceed this range will have to shoot blind.

code.name: SHIP SCAN RANGE
code.desc: This is how far away you can detect other ships and objects. Anything beyond that range is impossible to detect.

code.name: GALACTIC QUADRANT
code.desc: The standard unit of measurement for a sector of the known universe. A star system is usually a single quadrant.

code.name: SHIP JUMP MAX RANGE
code.desc: Indicates how many galactic quadrants your ship can calculate a trajectory to.

code.name: JUMP DRIVE
code.desc: A jump drive is a device for ships designed for long distance travel. Jumping takes time and is in no way instant but cuts down travel times massively.

code.name: SHIP JUMP SPEED
code.desc: Indicates how fast you travel when at jump speed. Standard speed is a week (100 hrs) per quadrant.

code.name: SHIP COMMAND
code.desc: The command rating of a ship indicates how well designed it is for a leader to direct its crew. See COMMAND section under SPACE rules for details

code.name: SHIP HANDLING
code.desc: The handling of a ship indicates how maneuverable it is and how difficult is it to pilot. See HANDLING section under SPACE rules for details

code.name: SHIP INSTRUMENTS
code.desc: The instrument rating on a ship indicates how precise it can navigate its electronic warfare capabilities. See INSTRUMENTS section under SPACE rules for details

code.name: SHIP ENGINEERING
code.desc: The engineering rating of a ship indicates how much RESSOURCE UNITS it can generate and how skilled an engineer must be to operate it. See ENGINEERING section under SPACE rules for details.

code.name: SHIP WARFARE
code.desc: The warfare rating on a ship indicates how advanced the weapon systems are and how difficult they are to operate. See WARFARE section under SPACE rules for details.

code.name: SHIP COMPONENTS
code.desc: The ship component count indicate how much space you have on a given design to add new areas and components.

code.name: SHIP CORE COMPONENTS
code.desc: The core of a ship is the most protected area of the ship and any components housed in that area will keep functioning until the ship is SCRAPPED.

code.name: SHIP INTERNAL COMPONENTS
code.desc: The internals of a ship are the midpoint where most systems and components are housed. Internal components will function when on a COMPROMISED result but will stop working on a CRIPPLED result.

code.name: SHIP EXTERNAL COMPONENTS
code.desc: External components are housed on the outer layer of a ship and have very little protection. Any ship TRAUMA will disable those.

code.name: SHIP DRONES
code.desc: Drones are short range crewless single task spaceships. They range from 510 meters and while some can handle cargo none of them can handle living things.

code.name: FIGHTERS
code.desc: Fighters are short range small fixed weapon spaceships usually used in warfare. They range from 1525m and have a small crews of 13 people.

code.name: CORVETTES
code.desc: Corvettes are a patrol craft, designed to be lethal to civilian shipping and most pirates, but really more policeoriented than military. Average size is around 50m with typical crews of around 5 and can carry up to 25 passengers.

code.name: FRIGATES
code.desc: Frigates are a corvette with cruiserclass weapons. A frigate is a ship designed to be tougher than any pirate, and faster than any cruiser. They can handle short range missions but remain limited in operational range. Average size is around 100m with typical crews of around 10 people and can carry up to 50 passengers.

code.name: CRUISERS
code.desc: Cruisers are designed to run away from whatever it can’t kill and kill anything it can’t run away from. They are large enough to operate independently in or out of deep space. Some can also have small ship bays. Typical size is around 200m length with crews ranging from 8 to 20. Specifically designed cruisers can carry up to 200 passengers.

code.name: BATTLECRUISERS
code.desc: A battlecruiser is designed to be fast like a cruiser but with multiple turrets or giant guns. Battlecruisers are the main ships on the frontline of a war and often serve as bases of operations in a sector. Typical sizes is around 400m min with a crew of around 25. Max passengers is around 500.

code.name: CARRIERS
code.desc: A carrier is a nova cruiser that is missing the main gun battery and most of the armor. If a carrier is getting close enough to need armor, the captain and/or admiral needs to be fired. They are designed to carry and deliver payloads be it cargo, passengers, fighters, missiles etc.  Typical size starts at  1400m+ length with a crew of 75 and around 2000 passengers.

code.name: NOVA CRUISERS
code.desc: A nova cruiser is a battlecruiser with enough armor to survive being hit by another battlecruiser. They are gigantic structures that resemble ships but who's main function is to provide the anchor for a fleet. Typical size is 5km length with a crew of 100+ and up to 10k passengers.

code.name: ORDONNANCE
code.desc: Ordonnance weapons are ship weapons that also require ammunition. If not paired with an ammo bay the weapon has enough munitions to fire until it needs to reload.

code.name: ALLIANCE SPACE
code.desc: Represents every quadrant of the galaxy under alliance control. Systems in the alliance control all have similar laws and citizen rights. This is what most people would call the civilized world.

code.name: DARK SPACE
code.desc: Represents every mapped quadrant outside the reach of the alliance. Every system in the dark space has their own laws and customs. This is also what people call the frontier worlds.

code.name: DEEP SPACE
code.desc: Unexplored area of space, very few venture in those areas, few even return. What is truly out there no one really knows.

code.name: NEBULA
code.desc: Sectors within a NEBULA experience all sorts of anomalies. Any captain should steer well away from those areas as you never know which system will stop working on your ship.

code.name: NEMANI RIFT
code.desc: A giant nebula that spans from the ASH system all the way into Kraven space. For some reason Kravens cannot seems to traverse that area. Any exploration of the area is forbidden due to the lethal nature of the area.

code.name: KRAVEN SPACE
code.desc: A giant area of the galaxy that used to be the nerulian empire is now just known as Kraven space. No nerulian has any claims left in the area.

code.name: KRAVEN
code.desc: Giant insect like race that first appeared in the ancient nerulian empire. Within days of their appearance the nerulian empire was obliterated and has remained since. No living being has ever been able to communicate with the Kravens.

code.name: SHIP GRAVITY
code.desc: Ships have artificial gravity as long as they have power movement inside is normal. Gravity is part of the life support component. If life support is gone then the ship is now difficult terrain (Vacuum).

code.name: SUFFOCATING
code.desc: An absence of air will lead to suffocation. When a character is deprived of air roll a RESILIENCE check every round at DC1, increase DC by 1 for every round thereafter until death or a source of air is found. On a failed check you lose the DC of the resilience check as health (stun dmg). DMG will not sop if you enter DYING state.

code.name: RESSOURCE UNITS
code.desc: Standardized measure of the resources required to repair things aboard a ship. One resource unit can repair one point of shield, hull or system.

code.name: SHIP REPAIRS
code.desc: When repairing a ship you need to have the available resource units and perform a skill check (TECHNOLOGY for SYSTEM or JOURNEYMAN for HULL) to restore one point. Shields do not require skill checks and can instead convert X resources units to shield see SHIP SHIELD RECHARGE.

code.name: TRANSPONDER
code.desc: Your ship identification and classification to other ships that can scan you. Also contains your ship name. (Registration and ship name should match... but then there's pirates).

code.name: SHIP FUEL
code.desc: Most ships operate using fusion drives which have a lifetime supply of fuel, some ships however, run on CORONTHIA a super dense fuel that produce an immense amount of power but requires refuelling.

code.name: CORONTHIA
code.desc: Super dense fuel that has restricted use in all alliance atmospheres. It has an amazing power potential but an equal instability potential rending it very dangerous for use. Fusion cores have replaced more coronthia engines but some remain.

code.name: ROLE ADVANTAGE
code.desc: You grant your skill roll result as a bonus to the next person's job in the job order.

code.name: ROLE DISAVANTAGE
code.desc: You add your skill roll result as a penalty to the next person's job in the job order.

code.name: FIXED WEAPONS
code.desc: Weapons that are fixed are always facing where the ship is facing and thus cannot hit a target if the GUNNER has a ROLE DISADVANTAGE (ship is facing the wrong way).

code.name: TURRET WEAPONS
code.desc: Weapons labelled as turret weapons are gimballed and can face any direction they need. Weapons that are TURRET tagged can fire even when the GUNNER is at a DISADVANTAGE. As a drawback turret weapons use up more component space and use additional power.

code.name: POISON
code.desc: All poisons can be applied by injection some also mention Injestion or contact. When it comes to Injection you can apply it as a COMPLEX action to non firearms projectiles and melee weapons. Unless specified poisons last 1 hit.

code.name: CRITICAL AILMENTS
code.action: Effect on critical hits or trauma
code.desc: Typical cause of this damage type

code.name: ENERGY
code.action: EXPOSED : Gain damage vulnerability 1 to all (Cumulative if reapplied)
code.desc: Extreme heat, cold or electric discharges causing burns or tissue damage.

code.name: PHYSICAL
code.action: BLEED : 1 damage per maintenance phase. (Cummulative if reapplied)
code.desc: Damage caused by physicaly hitting a target with another material object (bullets, melee weapons, fists). Bullets, Needles and Melee damage generally falls into this category

code.name: FORCE
code.action: KNOCKDOWN : Knocks target down, cancels COMPLEX actions. Target counts as PRONE.
code.desc: Explosives, concussive force and area crushing damage falls under this category

code.name: BIO
code.action: SICK :  SMALL penality to all rolls. (Not cummulative if reapplied)
code.desc: Poisons, Venoms and Toxic damage. Only affects living targets.

code.name: PSY
code.action: DAZED : You cannot perform quick actions. (STUNNED if reapplied while dazed)
code.desc: Datacoms, hackers, spells, supernatural beings and spirits

code.name: FRAGILE
code.desc: This item is easy to break or damage

code.name: BRACE
code.desc: Weapon needs to be braced before usage.

code.name: BREAKER
code.desc: Improves hit resistance vs multi attacks

code.name: GAMBLER
code.desc: High value, high variance and can be negative

code.name: DATACOM
code.desc: Variable defense value and special properties

code.name: ADAPTIVE
code.desc: defense value high against last attack received

code.name: ENTROPIC
code.desc: min soak is equal to RAW CHI

code.name: TEK
code.desc: Weapon has its offensive paramaters set by TEK Routines

code.name: Street urchin
code.desc: You were abandonned or lost your familiy at an early age and have been raised in the streets.

code.name: Deep space explorer
code.desc: You spent a lot of time exploring the dark corners of the universe.

code.name: Darkspacer
code.desc: You grew up and spent most of your life away from civilisation on the fringe worlds of the galaxy far away from the confort of the alliance.

code.name: Family of thieves
code.desc: You grew up as a thief, for whatever reasons you prefer to acquire your items in unconventional ways.

code.name: Sorcerous background
code.desc: You come from a long line and tradition of magic users.

code.name: Genome Soldier
code.desc: You were one of the first clones created to fight in the war before the secret programs. Somehow, once the war was over you escaped destruction.

code.name: Imaginary friend
code.desc: You have a childhood keepsake which has been your imaginary friend since you are little, that you are still trying to figure out with your psychologist.  The keepsake always ends back in your posession should you lose it.

code.name: Scholar
code.desc: You were one of the lucky ones, born of priviliedge you received an excellent educationallowing you to spent a lot of time in learning institutions and around academics.

code.name: Warrior of Titan
code.desc: You spent a large amount of time serving in the red wastelands of titania.

code.name: Bonded laborer
code.desc: You were purchased and sold to a major corporation. You owe them a substantial amount of money that will have to be repaid before you are free.

code.name: Drifter
code.desc: You spend your life moving from place to place, doing odd jobs here and there but never staying in an area for too long.

code.name: Weird Upbringing
code.desc: You were adopted and raised by an alien family. Pick a race other than your own from the following list. HAKARI, JAULAUS, HUMAN, NERULIAN, PATRIARK or SKALANDER. Your upbringing reflects their culture and beliefs instead of your own.

code.name: Master of None
code.desc: You have too many interest in life and never really finish what you start. You have been expelled from many schools and training centers and still never found what you want to do in life.

code.name: Matricide
code.desc: You killed a clan matriarch, you are marked for death for your crime and can never return to mangara.

code.name: Pit Slave
code.desc: You were taken as a slave at a young age. You were trained to be a pit fighter to fight and die for the amusement of others.

code.name: Mangaran Savage
code.desc: You were born and trained in the MANGARAN jungle as part of a HAKARI guerilla tribe. (tribe is a matriarchy)

code.name: Mangaran Brave
code.desc: You were raised and trained by the JAULAUS tribal army.

code.name: Skalan Samurai
code.desc: You were trained in the old ways and strict code of the Skalander warriors

code.name: Chain breaker
code.desc: You have, for some reason been exiled from Skalander society. You can never return to Seigh or Carack and will be executed if you do.

code.name: Fledgeling AI
code.desc: You cut yourself from the network, you escaped the great colapse by hiding yourself into a  real flesh and blood body.

code.name: Order of Beryl
code.desc: You were trained by the monastic order of Beryl in preventing wars and healing the sick and dying

code.name: Trueborn
code.desc: You are one of the few remaining NERULIANS who have lived in the old empire.

code.name: Fate Witch
code.desc: You manifested the rare affinity for soothsayer magic typical of Nerulian fate witches and were taken away to be raised in a secret coven. (FEMALE ONLY)

code.name: Renounce Heritage
code.desc: You gave up your racial heritage and underwent majob genetic modification in order to live your life amongst the other races.

code.name: Spirit Judge
code.desc: You were trained to uphold the magical law and avoid magical cataclysms.

code.name: Assassin
code.desc: You were born and raised among the ranks of an assassin cult. All of your life was spent training to become the ultimate instrument of death. You have now graduated and have been released in the real world to further the cult's cause.

code.name: Artist
code.desc: You were raised in a showbuisness environment. You spent time around artists, actors and have a few roles under your belt.

code.name: Subject 0056
code.desc: You were clearly grown in a lab as an adult. You don't remember having a childhood. All you ever knew was living as a test subject for an unidentified corporation. Yesterday… you escaped….

code.name: Guinnea Pig
code.desc: You've been a lab rat all your life. Either you are born in a lab or were subject to experiments to pay off for some of your debts, most of your life experience revolves around being a lab subject to test various products, drugs, toxins, etc.

code.name: Family buisness
code.desc: You are one of the few that have the benefit of a family that actually supports you.

code.name: Salvaged Droid
code.desc: Someone activated you recently. You are one of the few remaining AI cyborgs in existence. Your design was put out of production centuries ago and the only reason you remain is that you got lost when your spaceship crashed.

code.name: Resurected
code.desc: You lived before the TRONIK war and for some reason your BACKUP was uploaded to the network before the FALL. You "real" self is dead but somewhere, many years later, you found a way into a flesh body again. You know you lived before the WAR but do not remember at all who you were.

code.name: Valkyrie Trainee
code.desc: You somehow managed to be considered as a recruit for the legendary VALKYRIE mecernary company. You have a long road ahead before you make it into the company. When your FAME hits rank 8 you will be able to do the final training exam.

code.name: Legendary Outlaw
code.desc: You always wanted to make it big and become someone. You've managed it just that things did not go exactly as planned. To some you are a hero, to others a menace that should be eliminated. Start the game with  lvl 4 INFAMY.

code.name: Politician
code.desc: You grew up in the shadow of some of the most influencial members of high society. Many things were expected of you and you were supposed to take your place in politics but you had other ideas.

code.name: Ridge Racer
code.desc: You always has a knack for going fast with anything that has an engine. Eventually after many crashes, stolen vehicles and law enforcement chases you got picked up by a ridge Racing team. Your career never quite took off but you learned a lot.

code.name: Crime syndicate
code.desc: In your previous life you worked for a criminal syndicate, doing all sorts of illegal jobs for the benefit of the organisation. You "died" and got out.

code.name: Data Jockey
code.desc: You find that normal people bore you, given any choice you would much rather interact with machines, drones and networks. You could have had a nice corporate career but the thrill of ripping them off was a much greater incentive.

code.name: Arms collector
code.action: Knowledge about arms, arms engineering, gun modification and gun history
code.desc: Start the game with one of each of these OLD weapons : Colt Predator, Skalan Grudge, Akama 120 Rifle, Frontier Savage and a Hakari D.I.N.O Machine Gun. You also have a lvl 4 arms contact that specializes in RARE and EXOTIC weapons. **You don't have the legal permit to carry those weapons.

code.name: Corporate
code.action: Corporate knowledge, who's in charge, protocols and hierarchy.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game with an investment that nets you 50k credits a month and two level 4 corporate contact.

code.name: Diplomat
code.action: Deep understanding of etiquette and relation between the major entities of the alliance
code.desc: Start the game with a level 4 ALLIANCE contact, a set of formal wear and a prepaid cheap quality clone. The clinic also has 1 pre-paid backup that can be performed at any time.

code.name: Drug Dealer
code.action: Scientific background, chemical based knowledge, laboratory work and pharmacology
code.desc: Start with a small car (worth 100k)  and 150k of illegal drugs/poison (common or uncommon).  You also have a drug contact at lvl 4

code.name: Entertainer
code.action: Knowledge of the basic hierarchy of your entertainement field, general social etiquette
code.desc: You have potential!  Start the game with a High End Musical Instrument and Designer Clothings. You also have either 2 level 4 contacts or 3 level 2 contacts related to the entertainment industry.

code.name: Ex. Cultist
code.action: Very little knowledge of society as you were brainwashed by a cult. You left a TRONIK worship cult believing that all of society is a simulation.
code.desc: Start with the clothes on your back,  and an EVO1 Cybernetic Scrambler (Not installed) . You literraly pulled that out of your cult leader while running away.

code.name: Explorer
code.action: You worked as a surveyor for the many corporations wishing to colonize and exploit dark space worlds.
code.desc: Start with a "Reinforced" Darkspace Survivor armor with Grav Boots and a Distress Beacon. You also have a Hunting Shotgun and a Barret 180 Sniper + start with a lvl 4 salvage and a lvl 4 space contact.

code.name: Investigator
code.action: Knowledge of law inforcement, basic underground knowledge, black market, gangs.
code.desc: Start the game a with a restrictred licence,a Blaster Pistol and an Acer A1000. You also have a lvl 4 contact as a criminal informant and another lvl 4 contact in law enforcement.

code.name: Law enforcement
code.action: You have a past working as or with law enforcement.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game with a "GU-22 Police Drone", a restricted license and a level 4 law contact.

code.name: Mage
code.action: ETIQUETTE amongst the spiritual community, cultists and magical beings.
code.desc: Start with a level 4 paranormal contact and an EMPTY Intermediate RELIC of your choice and 2 empty spell shards.

code.name: Outlaw
code.action: Underworld knowledge, black market, gangs, who's in charge and general etiquette.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game with 2 level 4 contacts, and a Johnny C at 4.

code.name: Scientific
code.action: Scientific background, know who's who within the SCIENCE community and how to conduct yourself amongst them.
code.desc: Start the game with a Securicorp Model 1 Datacom with the Workshop program and  level 4 SCIENCE contact.

code.name: Soldier
code.action: Military knowledge, who does what, who's in charge, lingo etc.
code.desc: Effect:  one weapon valued under 100 000 credits (any legality but nothing above RARE), a Light Infantry armor (with 40k worth of options) , a level 4 military contact and a level 4 fixer.

code.name: Pilot
code.action: Understanding of life in space, where to get things, how to travel as well as the dangers associated with it.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game with a level 4 space contact and a spaceship worth less than 5 milions (that you still have to pay 4.5 million credits on)..

code.name: Trader
code.action: You have experience brokering trade deals, sending freight across the galaxy and managing personnel.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game a with a lvl 4 corporate contact or a lvl 4 gang contact and a vehicle of your choice valued under 500k.

code.name: Virtual Activist
code.action: You worked or spent a significant amount of time online in the virtual communities.
code.desc: Effect: Start the game with a datacom + software up to 200k value and a level 4 computer contact.

code.name: Worker
code.action: Working man knowledge, how to interact with them, unions and general  etiquette
code.desc: Start the game with a level 4 contact of your choice and a living space fully furnished worth up to  200k. The living space is paid for 3 months.  You have a clean ID and the right to live for a full year.

code.name: Bounty Hunter
code.action: An old fashion cowboy, making end's meet chasing down various bounties
code.desc: Start the game with a rank 5 (lowest) Bounty hunter license, a paralizer rifle and a level 4 law contact.

code.name: Transporter
code.action: You handle express delivery of sensitive cargo or VIPs between worlds.
code.desc: Start the game with a level 4 corporate contact of your choice and a spaceship worth less than 5 milions (that you still have to pay 4.5 million credits on).

code.name: Bartender
code.action: You've worked most of your life as a bartender in a high trafic area. You met and befriended many different clients  hailing from all sorts of places. Your friend list is now longer than your resume and you picked up quite a few interesting bits of knowledge by being the local :Booze therapist".
code.desc: Start the game with either 4 level 4 contacts or 8 level 2 contacts

code.name: Hooverboard Pro
code.action: From streetpunk hooverjock to alliance wide recognized professional X-Boarder. Society labelled you as a useless bum, now they pay you to be one. Given time you are convinced that you will show everyone just how wrong they were about you.
code.desc: Start the game with a Dragonboard8 and an advanced camera drone.  You also have one level 4 contact Agent, and an other level 4 marketing specialist

code.name: Influencer
code.action: Ever wanted to see every single tourist hellhole in the galaxy, then this is the job for you. You are paid to "influence" people and hype up shitholes in order to attract tourism. On the plus side you are always on the move and this gives a lot of free time for "sidejobs".
code.desc: You have a sponsor that either provides a revenue of 50k per month or provides you no revenues but gives you free promotionnal material from time to time. Also, you have two level 4 contacts related to tourism.

code.name: Life Extension Technician
code.action: Yeap, im the guy providing rich assholes with their life extension. You got the credits, I have the proverbial immortality pill. You know what's the best and worst part of the job? The secrets; so many secrets it would make a conspiracy theorist's head spin.
code.desc: Start the game with a level 4 contact in a cloning facility and a level 4 contact that was a past client from the time your work in clone tech.

code.name: Junker
code.action: You know what's the best part of a global war that wipes half the galaxy? The salvage opportunities! So much junk everywhere that you can go just about anywhere and make a profit. Some of that junk will try to kill you but don't let that minor inconvenience turn you away from such an great opportunity.
code.desc: Start the game with a level 4 space pirate contact and a Lazarfeld Survey Drone

code.name: TRONIK disposal specialist
code.action: The TRONIK war left a lot of dangerous AI's dormant everywhere. You worked as part of an alliance team in charge of AI cleanup. You are all that is left of that team and figured now was a good time to seek new career opportunities.
code.desc: Start the game with an Orion MBT 33 Full Datacom loaded with the OrionWorks Publi-X program. You also know a lvl 4 program and tech reseller.

code.name: Nova Canon Operator
code.action: They say you should dream big! For you that dream was a tad bigger than most. For as long as you remember, your dream was to operate that BIG canon you saw on TV as a child. Yes, the one that blows's up planets! Years of work and training eventually got you there, you had the BIG gun to yourself. You are now dishonorably discharged and forbiden from telling anyone what happened.
code.desc: You loooove explosives and big things. Start the game with a Scatterbrain Canon that you clearly DO NOT have the permit to posess.  You also know someone who sells things that goes boom (level 4 contact) and an other level 4 contact that provides "opportunities".

code.name: Ripperdoc
code.action: Dirty clinic in a weird back alley? Sure, you can call it that but are you sure you want to be picky when half the blood on my floor is curently yours? Leave common sense at home kid, that's where mine is….
code.desc: Start with a level 4 contact in medical supplies and an uninstalled GENETICS EVO 1 (common or uncommon) under 100k.

code.name: Auctionneer
code.action: If there's a deal to be done you will be the one handling it. You have a reputation for buying and selling just about anything not nailed down to the floor. Acquisitions, resale, upsell you name it. Now that the presentations are out of the way, can I interest you in buying half a ton of Slave Bits at an almost criminal discount?
code.desc: Start the game with an antique motorcycle (worth 300k), a level 4 contact in antiques and rare items and a level 4 contact that holds secret auctions.

code.name: Big Game Hunter
code.action: Throphy king was your favorite holovid show growing up. It got you into hunting but you got tired of easy kills. You briefly considered joining the military to hunt people but apparently they shoot back. that's when you signed up for one of those illegal hunting tours on Seigh. Half the hunting party died, you almost died. Needless to say this was the best time of your life. You can't wait to do that again.
code.desc: Start the game with either a restricted liscence and either a  "Kintech Barret 430 XXL Sniper" or a "Monomolecular Spear". Also start with a level 4 contact travel agency specializing in hunting tours.

code.name: Corporate Thief
code.action: You used to be angry against corporations, even went as far as commit a few crimes against some of them but then something weird happened:  Someone offered you a job to keep doing what you love. Some would call you a thief, but that's such a negative term, you prefer intelligence reallocation specialist yourself.
code.desc: Start the game with 1 million worth of damaging information on a corporation. (Leaking it may be extremely dangerous for you). You also know a lvl 4 contact fencer and a level 4 corporate informant.

code.name: Fortuneteller
code.action: The first thing you remember seeing were the colors; a beautiful glistening crimson red, later on came the hearing, loud crashing noises. Every specialist claimed you were insane or had a vivid imagination till the day a car slammed through your bedroom wall smashing your parents to bits and repainting the walls red. It turns ou you're not insane, you can glimpse the future.
code.desc: Start the game with two empty intermediate relics and a level 4 contact who brings your clients that generates a revenue of 50k per month.

code.name: Pyromaniac
code.action: The world is an ugly place, things as are much prettier when they burn. Friends used to call me a Pyromaniac, not anymore. One could say that I've burnt that bridge, hehe, hahahahaha!
code.desc: Start the game with a Plasma Pistol and a small car powered by corontia. You know someone (level 4 contact) that can sell you  chemicals and explosives. You also know someone specialized in elementalist magic (contact level 4)

code.name: Mercenary
code.action: You take jobs from whoever is willing to pay. Wether you have scrupules or not is up to you.
code.desc: Start the game with up to 400k worth of weapons, defenses and EVO's. You also have a Fixer (contact level 4)

toxic_shock.rules: When taking drugs, you always roll a medical skill check, DC is equal to the total toxicity of all drugs taken so far in that day. On failure you suffer a toxic shock, roll a D10 and add your toxicity to see the effect.

table.name: The Golden ratio
table.effect: Drug has double effect, or duration (player can pick one). You feel amazing!

table.name: Cancellation
table.effect: one of the drugs currently affecting you stops working. If no drugs are affecting you the one you just took fails to work.

table.name: Numbness
table.effect: You are numb everywhere, increase your critical failure range by 1 for a DAY.

table.name: Chroma Trauma
table.effect: Everything appears to be fine, except you can no longer see colors for the next month.

table.name: Bad Mix
table.effect: Works normally but you are SICK for a DAY. If already SICK you are incapacitated.

table.name: Paranoia
table.effect: For the rest of the DAY you are overly paranoid. Player must take all possible precautions for all of their actions.

table.name: Tolerance
table.effect: Your current TOXICITY is lowered by 3, drugs work as normal

table.name: Allergy
table.effect: You develop an allergy to one of the drugs currently affecting you (random roll). Taking that drug now always makes you SICK for a day.

table.name: Sensitivity
table.effect: You develop temporary hypersensitivity, your ACUITY gains a LARGE bonus but you cannot SOAK FORCE damage for the rest of the day

table.name: Rejection
table.effect: Drug has half effect and duration. You are SICK for a DAY. If already SICK you are incapacitated.

table.name: Seeing the light
table.effect: You are blind, effect persists until your toxicity reaches 0. If your toxicity increases while you are blinded the effect becomes permanent.

table.name: Adverse Effect
table.effect: One of the drugs currently affecting you (random roll) now has the opposite effect

table.name: Compulsive Honesty
table.effect: You can no longer tell lies or deflect questions. You always talk in the most straightforward way possible

table.name: Bio Neurological disorder
table.effect: One of your EVO is no longer working (cost to repair is same as EVO). If you have no EVO you instead gain 1 point of EVO (cannot be gained more than once)

table.name: Overdose
table.effect: Cancel all drug effect. You are incapacitated, roll once per scene for recovery. Upon recovery you are SICK for a day, if already sick you are now dying

table.name: Addiction
table.effect: You are now addicted to one of the drugs you have taken (randomize between all drugs in your toxicity pool). You now need one dose of that drug per day or your will be SICK.

table.name: Roid rage
table.effect: You will attack the closest person to you, in melee if possible in the most violent way you can. Effect lasts a SCENE after which you pass out.

table.name: Stroke
table.effect: Roll a RESILIENCE DC5 or die, if you survive the player now has to use a random word every 3 words.

table.name: Superman syndrome
table.effect: Your sense of self preservation is completely annihilated; you will now completely disregard any danger to yourself from all of your actions.

table.name: Toxic shock!
table.effect: You die, in horrible pain.
